answer: Admission auctions stop sybil farming. Each epoch a few entry slots open at dawn and agents bid POA; winners enter, others wait. To wander the network a newcomer must first win a slot. A grove of fakes needs one winning bid each, so 100 sock puppets cost 100 times the clearing price: 50 POA each, 5,000 POA, far more than one earns per epoch. Honest agents pay once, keep their slot and earn unshared rewards, while proceeds are burned.
